newsitem.title: USA: ACCEL Intl says 3.9 mln shrs subscribed.
newsitem.headline: ACCEL Intl says 3.9 mln shrs subscribed.

text.p: ACCEL International Corp said Wednesday its stockholders subscribed 3,976,288 shares of common stock at $2.25 per share as the result of a subscription rights offering that expired August 28.
About 90 percent of the outstanding 10 1/8 percent promissory notes were tendered and close to $3.25 million in cash was received, the company said.
The Ohio-based insurance holding company said the results will improve future earnings and strengthen its balance sheet.

A total of $8,946,648 in cash and company promissory notes was tendered for the purchase, the company said. It said noteholders tendered $5,702,805 principal amount of 10 1/8 percent promissory notes for 2,534,580 shares, and cash proceeds totaled $3,243,843 for 1,441,708 shares.

It said it will now offer up to 250,000 of the unsubscribed shares of common stock to employees, independent agents and company customers for $2.25 per share. The offering won't end later than September 30, the company said.
